redfin.remarks: Fully Renovated 1BD/1BA at 14159 Riverside Dr, #103 Move right into this beautifully updated one bedroom, one bath condo, completely redone from top to bottom. The kitchen has been newly remodeled with sleek stone countertops, and the bathroom features an updated vanity and matching countertop. Recessed lighting throughout gives the space a clean, modern glow, while durable composite wood flooring runs seamlessly from room to room. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry , your own private balcony for morning coffee or evening relaxing, and two dedicated parking spaces — a rare find. This turnkey unit is ready for its next owner.
